coaching.title: Race Eve Shakeout
coaching.message: Just 15-20 min (about 2 mi), very easy, flat if you can find it. This is only to loosen the legs and wake up the nervous system, not to build fitness — that work is banked. Keep it well before your bib pickup and walkthrough so legs stay up the rest of the day.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: Tonight's dinner should be the one you've already tested — familiar, carb-forward, low fiber and low fat, nothing new. Keep sipping water with electrolytes through the day. Set out race breakfast now: oatmeal, banana, peanut butter, toast, coffee if that's your habit, eaten about 3 hours before the gun with 500 ml water and electrolytes.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Lean into today's lymphatic drainage session on the legs, then stay off your feet — legs up between logistics stops. You've got a sleep block on the calendar starting 8pm; protect it. Final gear check and drop bag before you wind down so there's nothing left to think about at bedtime.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: The Julian Alps' 2,700m of climbing rewards patience, not heroics tomorrow. Walk it through one more time: patient miles 1-10, find rhythm and power hike 11-20, let the training carry you 21-31. Trust the work — it's done. Tonight is just about staying calm and getting to the start line rested.
